intent.proves: At least one user or group carries a custom user-and-group type other than the system account type.
intent.scope: AccessUser rows with AccessUserUserAndGroupType set, excluding SystemAccount

bindings.reason: UserModel type projection and complete paging not implemented in mcp-count.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser WHERE ISNULL(AccessUserUserAndGroupType,'') NOT IN ('','SystemAccount')
